plugins.prepareCmd:
NEXT_RELEASE_VERSION=${nextRelease.version} python3 - <<'PY'
import os, re
from pathlib import Path
version = os.environ['NEXT_RELEASE_VERSION']
for rel_path in ['Cargo.toml', 'backend/Cargo.toml']:
    path = Path(rel_path)
    if not path.exists():
        continue
    text = path.read_text()
    pattern = re.compile(r'^(version\s*=\s*")([^"]+)(")', re.M)
    new_text, count = pattern.subn(lambda match: f'{match.group(1)}{version}{match.group(3)}', text, count=1)
    if count:
        path.write_text(new_text)
PY
